Hagane: Bridge
Miles
What on earth is happening?!@Report the situation!
Eita
The giant ship that transferred in fired@a high-output energy beam, and it scored@a direct hit on Rabulpaila!
The main body split in two and broke into@countless pieces of debris! It's leaving orbit!
Is anything going to fall to Earth?!
No! The hit came from behind along its orbit,@so it was accelerated away from Earth!
They calculated that into the attack...?!
Tetsuya
Th-They blew away that huge Rabulpaila@in a single shot...!
The Cross Gate Watch Fleet@appears to have taken damage as well!
Azuki
Incoming transmission from Princess Shana-Mia!@She says she has an urgent message!
Put her through!
Shana-Mia
Everyone on the Hagane,@that is Gaw-La Furia.
So it transferred here from beneath the moon...!
Yes... Most likely to eliminate Rabulpaila@and take control of the Gate of Voda...
Your Highness, can Gaw-La Furia's@large bow cannon fire repeatedly?
No. To fire again would take two hours@at maximum output, or about@20 minutes at minimum.
With a hull that big, it can't turn quickly.@Our ship can likely escape the line of fire,@but the damaged Cross Gate Watch Fleet...
...What does Gaw-La Furia intend to do@after taking the Gate of Voda?
I mean to send a transmission demanding@an answer to that very question.
And if there's no reply?
Then I shall go to Gu-Landon myself.@To end the war between the Fury and Earth.
Shana-Mia, I'm going with you.
Please do. Gaw-La Furia has a powerful@barrier, but the Throne Unit's Orgone Cloud@can neutralize it.
We can't send out@the Granteed Dracodeus alone.
It's the trump card for both us@and Gu-Landon, after all.
That's why we'd turn that against him...
I won't send you into the enemy's hands@for nothing. We've only just finished@the battle with Gadisword, and things are hard...
...but the Steel Dragons will advance on@Gaw-La Furia with everything we have.
Commander Miles...
What about permission from the Joint Chiefs?
I'll report it, of course, but we can't wait.@In 20 minutes, that bow cannon could be aimed@at Earth, the moon, or the colonies.
(I never thought the Commander would say that...)
The Fury may attack at any moment.@We'll stay ready to intercept while bringing@back units that need resupply or repairs.
Good. Once we're ready,@we storm Gaw-La Furia.
Near the Cross Gate
Gaw-La Furia - Interior
Fu-Ruu
Fu-Ruu Muru, reporting.
Gu-Landon
Earlier, Princess Shana-Mia contacted me.@She demanded to know my aims.
Did you answer her?
No.
Then Her Highness will attack Gaw-La,@together with the Steel Dragons.
...Fu-Ruu,@you and I are now the only knights@left in the Furia Holy Knights.
Let us fight to the end, for Al-Van's sake too.
Indeed.@And wield your sword as the next@Knight Commander.
(Lord Gu-Landon means to become@the new Emperor of the Fury...)
(But even if I become Knight Commander,@the only one truly allowed by his side@is she who may ride the Throne Unit...)
I command you as Knight Commander.@Destroy the Earthlings who stand@in Gaw-La Furia's way.
Then retrieve Her Highness and the Throne Unit.@Understood?
Yes, my lord. Even if it costs me my life.
Gaw-La Furia - Cell
(That tremor earlier was no ordinary thing.@Could Gaw-La Furia have risen?)
Fu-Ruu...
Gaw-La Furia has lifted off from the moon.
What...?!
I'm about to go fight the Steel Dragons@in a decisive battle...
I've unlocked it. You're a free man now.
This isn't Gu-Landon's will.@Is it your own decision?
Yes.
Why are you doing this?
Let me see... If I had to name it, atonement.
What do you want me to do,@now that you've let me out?
How you'll use your life,@what you'll accomplish as a knight...@Perhaps that's what I want to know.
Steel Dragons
Hagane - Hangar
Hurry up with the resupply!@I wanna launch right now!
Launch? Where are you planning to go?!
There might still be survivors@in Rabulpaila's wreckage!
If we don't hurry, it'll drift out of orbit@and we won't be able to recover anyone!
B-Brother... After that, there's no way...
We don't know that for sure yet!
But...@a-after being blown to pieces like that...
Fairy
Sieg... We might be the only Gadisword@people left alive...
D-Don't say that!
The Cross Gate Watch Fleet is searching@for survivors now, but most likely...
Ugh...
Ugh... Ungh...
(Sally...)
Fairy, Sieg, Sally... We're about to launch@an assault on Gaw-La Furia,@but you three don't have to take part.
Head to the Cross Gate Watch Fleet now.@I'll let them know you're coming.
...No, I'm joining the operation too.@I'm not letting the bastards inside@Gaw-La Furia off the hook!
...Sieg, I understand how you feel.@I'm angry too.
But fighting the Fury for that reason alone@isn't right.
Why not?
We were led by a misguided leader@named Herluga, too.
It is just as Fairy says.@Turning the sins of a ruler the people never chose@against those people only breeds more misery.
That is exactly why I must be the one@to stop Gu-Landon.
It was my failing as a member of the imperial@family that let him run rampant.
Your pride and your duty both demand it...?
That is correct, Princess Shine.
I'll help too.@I have something to ask Gu-Landon@about Fabula Foresse.
Me too. There's a man in Gaw-La Furia@I have to see.
...Al-Van Ranks, isn't it?
That's right.@What he's thinking in a situation like this...@what he means to do. I want to find out.
I... feel the same way.
In short, you want to rescue@the guy they've got locked up.
Don't get the wrong idea. I just want the truth.
(Sheesh, she sure isn't honest with herself.)
OK, White Lynx.@When it comes to clearing the air between a man@and a woman, nothing beats talking face to face.
That's not what I meant...!
Rescuing a captive prince is a pretty rare case,@but count me in~
Me too. You still have a chance.
Captain Aya...
Be honest with yourself.@That might open up a way forward.
Yes...@As the Captain says, I think you still have@a chance to bridge the gap that's grown between you.
Unlike us...
(She means Voat Nikolaus...?)
Princess Shana-Mia, I'll cooperate with you too.@Not for revenge, but as someone who shares your goal.
Our goal...
Right, Fairy and Shana-Mia have both been@working to stop the fighting on Earth...
Thank you, everyone...@It's truly reassuring.
(If I can share bonds like this@with people born on another world...)
(...then perhaps the future E-Selda and I wished for@isn't so far away...)
(So it's finally time for the showdown@with Gu-Landon and the rest...)
Katia
Touya...
Katia, we're going back@to Gaw-La Furia.
Yes... When we escaped from there,@I knew it would come to this. I'm ready.
I'm glad to hear you say that.
This time too... let's be sure to come back here.
Yeah.@And... I've been meaning to tell you this.@I'm glad I met you guys.
Huh...? What's gotten into you all of a sudden?
It's not like I've come to like fighting...@but I've learned a lot, and I think I can@finally protect someone important to me...
So, thanks.
I-I see...
Sorry for complaining so much at first.
It's fine, really.@More importantly, there's something I want to ask...
What's that?
That someone important you just mentioned...
Oh... I mean my friends, you know. Everyone.
Oh... Right. Of course.
Whaddya know, you two... were out here, huh?
We launch soon...
Yeah, I know.
The Granteed Dracodeus is the key to the next@operation. We're counting on you.
We'll back you up all the way.
Yeah, I'm counting on you.
When this fight's over, I'm going back to Sapporo.@Jinpu still owes me that salmon roe bowl@he promised, y'know.
Oh, that sounds great!
Then you guys come too.
...So what's the story behind that?
Well, back when we had a mock battle between@the Compati Kaiser and the Soul Saber at Mogami@Heavy Industries, Jinpu promised us.
But is it really okay...@to just add more people on our own?
Aw, c'mon! Let's see that famous@Hokkaido generosity in action!
(That old guy seems more like a Tokyo native, though.)
Seolla, Lato, you come too!
But...
If we each pay for ourselves,@it should be fine, right?
In that case...
Ugh, I gotta pay my own way too?
What about you, Touya, Katia?
Then let's invite Tenia and Melua too...@Oh, but Tenia eats a ton.@The money...
We might have to get part-time jobs to earn it.
Part-time jobs, huh...@I wonder if we can ever go back to that kind of life.
I don't know... but before that,@we have to end the fight with the Fury.
Tenia
Tenia, we're going back@to Gaw-La Furia.
When we escaped from there, I figured it'd come@to this. I'm ready.
This time too, let's be sure to come back here.
Huh...? What's with you all of a sudden?
W-Well, I guess... same here.@A guy I can really talk to like you...@that's, um... a first for me.
Was it?
Y-Yeah.@I mean, I'm kinda like this, you know?@I end up getting into fights right away...
(...I can remember one or two of those myself.)
That time... when we got caught in Gaw-La Furia@and were together... how do I put it... um...
What is it?
No, never mind. I'd rather hear you say it.
Hey, hey, Touya.@That someone important you mentioned... who is it?
Huh...
What?
Forget it! If we make it back safe,@you're buying me lunch!
Y-Yeah.
Me too, me too!@If it's rice bowls, I can easily put away five or six!
Me too!
What about you, Touya?
Well, let's invite Katia and Melua too...
Oh, and just so you know, Tenia...@you're paying your own way too.
Whaaat!?
Five or six salmon roe bowls costs a lot, you know.@You can't just tag along with Kota and get it free.
Then buy me that lunch, like I said!
I can't pay that much for one meal!
Hmph!@Guess I'll have to get a part-time job, then.
A part-time job, huh...
What is it?
I was just wondering if we can ever@go back to that kind of life.
Dunno... but before that,@we've gotta end the fight with the Fury.
Melua
Touya...
Melua, we're going back@to Gaw-La Furia.
Yes... When we escaped from there,@I thought it would come to this.@So I'm ready.
This time too... let's be sure to come back here.
Huh? What's wrong, all of a sudden...?
(Someone important...?)
O-Oh, I see.@I'm glad I met you too, Touya.
A lot of painful things happened,@but the reason we managed to get through them...
...is thanks to Katia, Tenia, Calvina,@Akimi, Akemi... and everyone@in the Steel Dragons.
Y-Yes...
What about you, Touya, Melua?
Then let's invite Katia and Tenia too...@Oh, but Tenia eats a ton.@The money...
We might have to get part-time jobs to earn it.
What's wrong?
I don't know... but before that,@we have to end the fight with the Fury.@With everyone's help.
Yeah... You're right.
Let's go. To Gaw-La Furia.
Earth Federation Army Southern Europe Army -@Aviano Base
Hiryu Custom Bridge
So that's what happened...
Daniel
That's right.@Given the change in circumstances, your destination@has changed from Rabulpaila to near Gaw-La Furia.
How long until the chemical weapons@are loaded and you're ready to weigh anchor?
Both will be finished in two more hours.
Very well.
Chairman... Is the Joint Chiefs' decision really@final? There are many civilians sleeping@inside Gaw-La Furia...
The decision stands. That giant spaceship@that destroyed Rabulpaila is a threat.
But the outcome can still change.@The Field Marshal intends to turn a blind eye@to the Hagane's actions.
Then...!
Carry out your mission. That said,@I won't tolerate any deliberate delays.
...I understand.
That is all, then.
Two more hours...
Sean
It's frustrating to be stuck here...@but let's trust in them.
Yes...
...Still not firing, even after we've come this far.@Are they afraid of damaging@the Granteed Dracodeus...?
Or are they confident in@Gaw-La Furia's defenses?
Perhaps it's both.
Chika
Hey, Master.@Can't you do something about that invisible@barrier with the Neo Granzon's power?
...That wouldn't give the desired result.@Besides, it wouldn't spur the awakening of@the Granteed Dracodeus or of Touya and the others.
...Shana-Mia.
I'll begin, Tou-Ya.
Yeah.
Shana-Mia Eterna Fura, First Princess@of the Fury, has returned home.
Whoever now commands Gaw-La Furia,@answer me.@Why have you raised Gaw-La...
I never gave such an order,@nor did I ever permit it.
Lady Shana-Mia,@the one in command of Gaw-La Furia@is Knight Commander Gu-Landon Gortz.
Then clear the way.@This battle must be brought to an end@at once.
That I cannot do.
Do you mean to turn your blades on me, your liege?
Oh my...@Is that something Your Highness can say, after@abandoning us and Gaw-La for the Steel Dragons?
That's because me and the Granteed Dracodeus...!
True, the war must be ended.@But mingling our blood with Earthlings@is another matter entirely.
I follow Lord Gu-Landon,@and I will take back Her Highness@and the Granteed Dracodeus.
Like hell we'll let you do that!
...Then all of you there share the same will?
Precisely.@We will not hesitate to use force.
Will Your Highness turn the Blade of the Imperial@Family on us? On the knights who seek to protect@the Fury's pure blood?
Shana-Mia...
Shana-Mia...
...I am acting not only for the Fury,@but for all the people who live@in the Earth Sphere.
If Gu-Landon's aim is to use the Gate of Voda@to bring calamity upon Earth...
...then I cannot let it pass.@Knights, clear my path.
If you will not obey me,@I am prepared to strike you down as traitors!
...You said it, Shana-Mia.
It'd be a problem if she wavered at this point.@She has to open the gates of the enemy castle for us.
(She's fighting the people who've always@protected her... There's no way she's fine with it.)
(She's fighting the people who've always@protected her... There's no way she's fine with it.)
(Princess Shana-Mia...@Had you been born a prince,@my heart would not be so torn...)
(I will stake my life on seeing@what my choice brings about.)
That woman knight... she has remarkable resolve.
We too are resolved never to retreat...@yet they have no just cause.
Oh my, a just cause belongs to the victor.@Surely your own history proves as much?
The Granteed Dracodeus is not the only@Blade of the Imperial Family.@Stop my blade's edge, if you can.
I am now Lord Gu-Landon's knight...@I will stop you, even at the cost of my life.
Touya, stay back.@We'll open a path for@the Granteed Dracodeus.
Touya, stay back.@The other units will open a path@into Gaw-La Furia.
You're the only ones who can get inside@and disable the barrier. Don't get hasty here.
Right.@...Shana-Mia, let's go.
Yes...!
(Lord Gu-Landon's cause and my atonement...@Heaven's mandate will fall on the worthy one...)
(All that's left is to let my blood boil@and fight to the end!)
Heh, heh heh...@It seems this is the end for me...
My knight's blood...@I've burned every last drop of it...
Fu-Ruu, eject!
Your... Highness... I... you...
Gaw-La Furia's barrier@is disappearing!
What!?
Fu-Ruu, could it be that you...?!
...At least some atonement... that was my choice...@But... this was... my fate...
Fu-Ruu!
Tou... Ya...@I'll tell Lord E-Selda... in Voda...
That your son... became the mightiest knight...
Fu-Ruu, could it be that you...?!
No... it wasn't me...@Most likely... Al-Van...
...?! What do you mean?!
Fu-Ruu!!
...Does that mean Al-Van@disabled Gaw-La Furia's@barrier...?
...You mean Al-Van@disabled Gaw-La Furia's@barrier...?
...Does that mean Al-Van@was the one who disabled@Gaw-La Furia's barrier...?
(Then he's alive, and in there...)
Gaw-La Furia's barrier@has completely vanished!
Captain...!
Good.@All units, storm the interior of Gaw-La Furia!
Your Highness... Having sided with the Earthlings,@you have no right to lead the Fury's people.
Turn your blade on me if you wish...@but you must not turn it on the people of Earth.
Lord Gu-Landon has no desire@to coexist with Earthlings.@And I...
You what?!
No... For Lord Gu-Landon's sake...@I will simply fight, staking my destiny on it!
Fu-Ruu, whatever resolve you have,@I'm breaking through here and going@inside Gaw-La Furia...!
To be reunited with Al-Van?
Not just that... I'll learn the truth@and stop Gu-Landon's ambitions!
I'm coming through, Fu-Ruu Muru!
Sänger Sombold...! A worthy foe to stake my life@against on this decisive battlefield!
Impossible, Gaw-La's barrier is gone...
Karo-Ran
Heh. It seems we had a traitor within.
Hardly what I'd expect to hear from the Chief Agent.
Don't you have someone in mind?
Behind the Steel Dragons stands the near-limitless@Earth Federation Army.@What do you intend to do?
I need only retake the Throne Unit.@With my own hands.
Oh? So the Knight Commander takes the front line@at last. Then we'll need to buy time.
I leave it to you.
Yes, Jua-Mu and I will go.@We'll meet the Steel Dragons inside Gaw-La.
